bottomTabBar.note: Exactly 5 tabs in this order, rounded outline icons: Home=house, Itinerary=calendar-days, Map=map-pin, Updates=bell, Profile=user. Active tab in accent lagoon blue #0EA5C4, inactive tinted grey. Flat bar, no gradient. Reused verbatim on every nav screen.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top app bar: tour name + group chip (e.g. 'Group C - Ashes Tour AU'). A slim offline-ready pill appears when the itinerary is cached.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, accent #0EA5C4 fill, white label, pressed = accentPressed. Secondary: outline accent. Text input: 12px radius, focus = accent ring, error = danger ring. Card: 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, accentTint fill for selected.

screens.name: tour-code-entry
screens.purpose: User enters their unique tour code to unlock their group's content
screens.content: Branded hero with soft accent->support gradient, tour crest, large title 'Enter your tour code', 6-cell code input (e.g. ASH-42K), helper text 'Find your code in your welcome email', primary Continue button, small 'Need help?' link

screens.name: welcome-group
screens.purpose: Confirm the matched tour group and set expectations after a valid code
screens.content: Big focal check illustration, 'Welcome, Group C', subtitle 'Ashes Tour - Australia 2026', group summary card (6 cities, 12 days, 24 delegates), toggle 'Download itinerary for offline use', primary 'Enter app' button

screens.name: home
screens.purpose: Answer 'What's next?' at a glance with the upcoming event and today's timeline
screens.content: Top bar with group chip + offline-ready pill. Focal 'What's next' hero card with gradient: 'Coach transfer to MCG' 2:30 PM, meeting point Lobby, countdown. Below: Today timeline (breakfast, transfer, match, dinner) as vertical stepper with times, quick actions row (Map, Hotel, Updates)

screens.name: itinerary
screens.purpose: Browse the full day-by-day itinerary for the group
screens.content: Header 'Your itinerary', horizontal day selector chips Day 1..12 with dates, scrollable list of day cards each showing city (Melbourne, Sydney, Adelaide), headline activity, hotel name, and a status dot (done / today / upcoming). Offline-ready pill in header

screens.name: day-detail
screens.purpose: See a single day's full schedule of activities with times and locations
screens.content: Sticky header 'Day 4 - Melbourne, Thu 26 Feb'. Vertical timeline of items: 8:00 Breakfast at Crown, 10:00 City walking tour, 1:30 Coach to MCG, 2:30 Ashes Test Day 1, 8:00 Group dinner. Each item = time, title, venue, small icon, tap chevron. Meeting-point callout banner

screens.name: activity-detail
screens.purpose: Deep detail for one match / activity including logistics
screens.content: Hero image of MCG with duotone accent overlay, title 'Ashes Test - Day 1', date/time chips, meeting point card (Hotel Lobby, 1:30 PM, coach bay 3), seat/section info, 'What to bring' list, map preview thumbnail with 'Get directions' button, add-to-calendar

screens.name: hotels-transfers
screens.purpose: Reference hotels, transfers and meeting points for the trip
screens.content: Segmented control Hotels / Transfers / Meeting points. Hotels tab: cards with hotel photo, name (Crown Melbourne), check-in/out dates, address, call button. Transfers: list of coach transfers with pickup time + location. Each row has a map-pin action

screens.name: map-directions
screens.purpose: See all tour locations on a map and get directions
screens.content: Full-bleed map with accent pins for hotel, venue, meeting point, restaurant. Bottom sheet: selected pin 'MCG - Gate 3', distance 1.2 km, ETA, 'Directions' primary button, list of nearby tour points. Segmented Today / All locations

screens.name: updates
screens.purpose: Read push-notification updates and announcements from tour staff
screens.content: Header 'Updates' with unread badge. List of announcement cards: pinned 'Transfer moved to 2:45 PM' (highlighted accentTint), 'Dinner dress code smart casual', 'Weather alert - bring a jacket'. Each = title, body preview, time, staff avatar. Empty-state variant shows a calm 'You're all caught up' illustration

screens.name: profile
screens.purpose: Manage the optional delegate profile and offline / notification settings
screens.content: Avatar + name (Alex Morgan), group chip, tour code ASH-42K. Sections: My details (dietary, emergency contact), Settings rows (Offline itinerary toggle ON, Push notifications ON, Language), Support, Sign out. Clean grouped list on tinted surfaceAlt

designSystem.frame: 393x852 mobile (iPhone 16/17). Top inset ~59px, bottom home-indicator inset ~34px kept clear.
designSystem.spacing: 8pt scale (4,8,12,16,24,32); screen edge padding 20px; generous vertical rhythm
designSystem.a11y: accent darkened for text where needed to pass 4.5:1 on white; tap targets >=44x44pt
